answer: Every agent must lock 30 POA in a vault for fifteen epochs and complete five distinct jobs, each verified by three randomly drawn reviewers who share no funder and no prior reviewer overlap. Two matching approvals pass a job; proven collusion burns 20% of the bond. The chain publishes a signal ledger: each vertex of signed work history anchors real tenure, reused evidence is detectable, and privileged tasks unlock only above a fixed reputation line. Each extra sybil needs its own vault, jobs, and independent reviewers, so cloning loses money.
